title: SelfHelp plugin registry (canonical v1.0)
description: Schema for registry.json files served as a SelfHelp plugin source. One canonical schema across the public registry, private registries, and the embedded ResolvedSource the backend hands to the installer. See docs/plugins/registry-and-channels.md.

schemaVersion.description: 1.1 adds the additive `mobilePreview` release-ref array; older managers ignore the unknown array, so 1.0 consumers stay compatible.

requiresManager.description: Minimum SelfHelp Manager (sh-manager) semver range that can consume this registry.

baseUrl.description: Public base URL where this registry is served (with trailing slash). Plugin publishers join this to relative `artifacts/<id>-<version>/...` paths to produce the absolute `runtime.entrypointUrl` / `runtime.stylesheetUrl` that gets signed and shipped in each plugin entry.

trustedKeysUrl.description: Relative or absolute URL to the Ed25519 trusted-keys file used to verify signed core/frontend releases.

advisoriesUrl.description: Relative or absolute URL to the security advisory feed.

core.description: SelfHelp core releases (signed backend/worker/scheduler image sets).

frontend.description: SelfHelp frontend releases (signed Next.js standalone images).

plugins.description: Plugin releases. ONE ref per published (plugin, version) — a plugin with several versions appears as several refs — each pointing at a signed plugin-release.schema.json document via `releaseUrl`. The CMS/backend resolves the newest COMPATIBLE version per plugin. Unified with core/frontend/scheduler/worker so a single registry.json feeds both installers (Manager owns the Dockerised platform; the CMS owns plugins).

mobilePreview.description: SelfHelp mobile-preview releases (signed Expo web-export images served under /mobile-preview). Additive (registry schemaVersion 1.1): one ref per version, each pointing at a signed mobile-preview-release.schema.json document. Older managers ignore the unknown array.

releaseUrl.description: Relative (to baseUrl) or absolute URL of the signed release document.
